name: @meshnet/desktop
//: No `build`, `typecheck` or `test` script on purpose: `pnpm -r build` runs on machines without a Rust toolchain, and a workspace-wide build should not start a native bundle. The desktop scripts are only ever asked for by name.

scripts.//windows: An x64 build for the machines that are x64; `tauri build` alone builds for the host, which on an ARM laptop is ARM64.
